newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across the board on Wednesday in moderate trade on some late local selling interest in line with lower Japanese prices, brokers said.
The Tokyo market also ended lower across the board, pressured by sporadic selling in reaction to the yen's firmer tendency against the U.S. dollar.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. But prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon in sympathy with weaker prices in Tokyo. Volume was moderate," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, June RSS3 fell one cent to 108.00 U.S. cents a kg.
October/December eased half a cent to 159.25 Singapore cents (US$1.10) a kg.
July TSR20 slipped 0.75 cent to 150.25 Singapore cents (US$1.04) a kg.
